gaps.title: Absence of High-Resolution Digital Micro-CT Trabecular Architecture Data
gaps.description: Currently registered gross anatomy textbooks (Latarjet, Nielsen) describe the cancellous core of the clavicle qualitatively but lack quantitative volumetric trabecular orientation tensors.

gaps.title: Discrepancy Between Latin TA2 Standards and Classical French Osteological Traditions
gaps.description: Morgue institutional notes emphasize the French description of the clavicle as "hueso plano alargado", whereas contemporary anglophone and TA2 curricula designate it as a modified long bone lacking a medullary canal. Both perspectives are preserved without declaring premature FIPAT certification.

gaps.title: Absence of Certified Primitives for Physiological Gliding Planes (Syssarcosis)
gaps.description: Certified repository relations contain articulates_with but lack formal ontology for false joints (syssarcoses) and directional ligamentous resistance vectors. Handled by proposing candidate relations RESISTS_DISPLACEMENT and SYSSARCOSIS_INTERFACE_BETWEEN.

gaps.title: Granular Fascial Boundary Definitions of Clavipectoral Fascia Suspensions
gaps.description: Detailed microscopic transitions between the subclavius sheath, clavipectoral fascia, and the suspensory ligament of the axilla (Gerdy) require axillary dissection depth and are deferred to Batch 3.

gaps.title: Cadaveric Age-Stratified Dissection Series for Acromioclavicular Disc Morphology
gaps.description: Photographic documentation of the regression of the AC joint meniscoid disc across young vs elderly cadavers is incomplete in current institutional morgue notes.

gaps.title: Orthopedic Fracture and Dislocation Classification Systems Held as Candidates
gaps.description: Clinical classification systems (Allman/Neer for clavicular fractures, Rockwood grades I-VI for AC separations) cannot be certified as canonical truth without authorized clinical specialty references.

gaps.title: Absence of Precise Geometric Coordinate Anchors in Current Viewer Meshes
gaps.description: No existing glTF/OBJ clavicular and pectoral girdle 3D assets in the repository currently have verified vertex indices for the 32 authored entities. All targets are preserved in UNMAPPED state.

gaps.title: Microvascular and Neural Innervation Penetration Mapping of the SC Articular Disc
gaps.description: Whether the fibrocartilaginous disc of the SC joint possesses intrinsic nociceptive nerve endings in its periphery versus being completely aneural is unresolved in gross anatomy textbooks.
